_: Timed windows and what they open and close, read by server/events.py (its docstring has the format): windows (daily times, windows laid over another's openings, calendar dates), spawns (the creatures of a location's own file that stand only while a window is open), held_out (of a file's own, never), quests (rows on offer only while a window is open), loot (a thing creatures carry in certain places), keep_in (things that exist in certain places only). The clock is the bosses' (server/bosses.py: Moscow time, LAVA_BOSS_CLOCK for a test), and nothing here is remembered: a server restarted in a window is in it. The bosses keep the owner's 14/18/22, the warehouse masters once a day at 20:00 (bosses.py); the rest keeps the times the map labels and the texts give. Every row says whether it is RECOVERED or DESIGNED.

prison_wh.why: RECOVERED. The uprising in Вади-Хальфа's prison (m8, the blocks 644-648 under the yard 176, 5985,1744): the yard's map label «Усиление режима в 12:00, 16:00 и 23:00» (res/database/locations.xml; the wiki's «Тюрьма Вади-Хальфы» the same), and the guard's call 62258: «каждый день в 12:00, 16:00 и 23:00 заключенным требуется усиленная охрана, длится это безобразие недолго, всего пол часа», its hint «"Охранять" заключенных нужно в течение 30 минут» (62272). The prisoners and the godfather stand while it is open. Not the bosses' 14/18/22: the owner's rule is for world bosses and camp chiefs, and the prison keeps the times its label gives.

prison_wh_gates.why: RECOVERED lead, DESIGNED end. The gates of the prison open a quarter of an hour before the uprising -- the label's «прибывать за 15 минут» -- and stay open while it lasts: the guards' ways into the blocks (161, 162), the station's ride to the yard (159) and the guard's hand-in of the invitation (158).

prison_wh_medics.why: RECOVERED. The medics who pay for the armbands, Джеф, Аль-Назир and Томпсон (877-879, the centre block 646), come for the last five minutes: «Сдать задание можно медикам, они появятся за 5 минут до завершения турнира» (62272, 62273).

wh_box.why: RECOVERED. The money boxes of Вади-Хальфа's three склады 109-111: the map labels' «Дележ добычи с 19:00 до 20:00» (res/database/locations.xml 315-317). Opens the holders' daily rows (data/holdings.json, server/holdings.py); the warehouse master keeps an hour of his own and comes once a day, right after the box: 20:00 by default (bosses.WAREHOUSE_HOURS, LAVA_WAREHOUSE_HOURS; the owner's «на складах хозяин должен прриходить один раз!!!», 2026-10-12), so a clan collects at seven and defends at eight.

ny.why: RECOVERED dates, the owner's default (plan, decision 22): the New Year «План Новогодних праздников» (62256) runs from «20 декабря» (the towns' trees) to «15 января 2016 года — Отключение новогодних квестов». Nothing of Вади-Хальфа's band stands by it yet: of the band's New Year residents, the children 423/425, the refugee 1977 and the lottery men 662/711 stand all year by the owner's default 5 (server/world.py SEASON_KEPT), Ольсен 431 stands nowhere (the default names him, but SEASON_KEPT leaves him out of 35 and 104 until his stall has goods of its own), the tree and Дед Мороз's company (Npc_Commoner000780-797) stand in no file, and the rest of the event runs through Донгола and the admin bunkers. Абри's band has two (the owner's Абри, 2026-10-12): the New Year of 2014's Дайсон and Канализационный люк (2426, 2427) in the Жилой квартал 188, who stood there all year until then (their token 'ng' is none of world.EVENT_TOKENS) and now stand in this window only (spawns, below).

may9.why: RECOVERED dates, the owner's default (plan, decision 22): from Victory Day to «Заказы принимаю до 2 августа» (46792-46800). The band's copy, 9may_*_WH (539-546, 571, 994, 995, level 6), is not stood in here: no way into it is recorded, its fighters' slots are empty, and its documents and awards have no item types found (see the handoff). Since 2026-10-13 every room of the event's war is out of the game (data/retired.json: the owner's cut of everything across the river; its staffs stood across the river), so the window has nobody to stand.

halloween.why: RECOVERED dates, the owner's default (plan, decision 22; the wiki's «Halloween 2015»). No creature of the band the client can draw belongs to it: the catacombs HW_cotakomb_*_WH put down types mobs.xml does not have.

feb23.why: DESIGNED dates, the owner's default (plan, decision 22: a week around the day). Its content (48959-48961, fevral23_exit 988 at 5851,1991) is around Абри and Мероэ, none of it in Вади-Хальфа's band.

Рашид's line sends the player to ambush Люшер's masters on the roads 144-146 («Пустошь: дорога», Q_DN_Road01-03), each master marked on the map in turn by the Сакиб of the road before: «Устрой засаду на Мастера Люшера. Он появляется в 00 минут каждый час в месте, отмеченном на твоей карте» (48683). The first master, on the first road (144), from the hour on; ten minutes, DESIGNED: the text gives no end, and at ten past the second comes.

lusher_road2.why: RECOVERED times, DESIGNED pairing (the owner's Донгола, 2026-10-13 («и потом сделай донголу тоже»), decision 43 of its plan). Рашид's line sends the player to ambush Люшер's masters on the roads 144-146 («Пустошь: дорога», Q_DN_Road01-03), each master marked on the map in turn by the Сакиб of the road before: «Он появляется там в 10 минут каждый час и будет доступен в течении 5 минут» (48686): the second master, on the second road (145).

lusher_road3.why: RECOVERED times, DESIGNED pairing (the owner's Донгола, 2026-10-13 («и потом сделай донголу тоже»), decision 43 of its plan). Рашид's line sends the player to ambush Люшер's masters on the roads 144-146 («Пустошь: дорога», Q_DN_Road01-03), each master marked on the map in turn by the Сакиб of the road before: «Он появляется там ровно в 20 минут каждый час и будет доступен в течении 5 минут» (48690): the third master, on the third road (146).

RECOVERED creatures and place, the window's time. The prisoners of the eastern cells (Prison_5_WH, «Тюрьма: Восточные камеры»), ten of them, as the northern ones.

held_out.why: DESIGNED. zapadlist_dvor, «Макисе Курису» (60386; the wiki: «злобный охранник, который наносит неприятные удары при помощи костыля», in the blocks a guard's way leads into), stands at the entrance of Prison_1_WH (titled «Северный блок»; west of the centre by its one opening, the wiki's «Западный блок», where the western gate leads). data/mob_types.json has it at level 20 by the highest place it stands in (the Абу-Хамед prison's), and nothing gives its level in Вади-Хальфа's: a level-20 hostile at the foot of the ladder of an m8 prison would kill whoever the gate lets in. Kept out until its level is known.
DESIGNED. The same guard at the entrance of Prison_2_WH (titled «Восточный блок»; south of the centre by its one opening, the wiki's «Южный блок», where the southern gate leads), for the same reason.

The owner's rule of 2026-10-10 («только по уровню городов») on the owner's Абри of 2026-10-12: the traders of Снаряжение Дредноута 17-18 ур and Снаряжение Паладина 19 ур (Npc_Trader000012/13, 10411/10412) sell nothing of Абри's band 8-12, so they do not stand in its clothing market (Sets_Market_Ab). The same types stand in the clothing markets of Донгола and Абу-Хамед (469, 467) as their files have them. The market itself is cut since (the owner's «и ещё убери локацию торговцы одеждой в Абри», 2026-10-12: data/retired.json); the row stays, as the cut assembly shop 1055's does, so the market stands as it stood if it comes back.

The owner's Абри of 2026-10-12, decision 22 of its plan: «Банкомат
Золото и серебро» (NPC_gold_craft_bank, 62143) in the smelter (OreRefinery_Abri) changed the dump's paper notes for gold (49782-49797: one note to 1.2 G and the like) -- a tap of gold with no known source of the notes, so its exchange is cut, and the machine does not stand.
The same machine in the assembly shop (OreRefinery_Abri_Sorting), for the same reason as in 766. The shop itself is cut since (no door leads in: data/passages.json 766).

The owner's cut of Абри, 2026-10-12 («... улучшение сетов 10-12 ...»): Npc_Upgrader000003, «Рудольф
Обмен одежды на вырост [9-12]» (the original's name), the set upgrader of Абри's band in its Жилой квартал (Abri_Settelment), the one file he stands in. His window is empty, as every set upgrader's is since the cut of Вади-Хальфа (server/setcraft.py), and he gives and takes no quest: he was the service the order takes away and nothing else, so he does not stand. Вади-Хальфа's Генри ст stays where he is because he gives quests (104, 105, 119, 132).

The owner's cut of Донгола, 2026-10-13 («и потом сделай донголу тоже»: the cut of Абри's kinds, decision 11 of its plan, taken for him): Npc_Upgrader000004, «Адольф
Обмен одежды на вырост [13-16]» (10480), the set upgrader of Донгола's band in its new market. Nobody upgrades a set since 2026-10-09 (server/setcraft.py: the only slice is off), so his window was empty, and he gives and takes no quest; Абри's Рудольф 5105 is held out of 188 the same way.

The same for dn_upg_muaz, «Муаз
Обмен одежды на вырост» (62324), in Донгола's old market: an empty window and no quest (decision 11).

The same for the black market of Донгола (decision 11): Simple_Upgrader «Мастер Тиль», whose window is empty since the set upgrade went off (2026-10-09) and whose quests are Вади-Хальфа's -- his way 146 is recorded under the town's black market 102 (data/passages.json quest), so here he would refuse it --; and Npc_Trader000002, the original's «Тестовый торгвец» (10401), a test trader with an empty stall (data/orig_names_manual.json 'none').

The same for Донгола's port (decision 10): Npc_Commoner000798, «Майор Свейн
Delta Force» (10350), the man of the clan base Delta Force, which is cut with all its files (data/retired.json): no quest, no service.

Донгола's «Упавший спутник» (77, on 5877,2004 since the owner's Донгола, 2026-10-13 («и потом сделай донголу тоже»), decision 12 of its plan): cosm_NPC_1 and Abri_Archa have no row, no wiki page and no role (data/orig_names_manual.json 'none'), and would show their internal names: the place is one to look at.

DESIGNED, as Вади-Хальфа's 644 (above; the owner's Донгола, 2026-10-13 («и потом сделай донголу тоже»), decision 46 of its plan): zapadlist_dvor, «Макисе Курису» (60386), the guard with the crutch, at the entrance of Донгола's Prison_1 («Тюрьма: Северный блок», the western gate's), where the gate leads in; his level 20 is the place's, and the blocks are for the uprising.
The same guard at the entrance of Донгола's Prison_2 («Тюрьма: Восточный блок», the southern gate's), for the same reason.

quests.why: RECOVERED times. The ride to the prison, «Поехали!» (62262/62263: «В 12:00, 16:00 или 23:00 отправиться в тюрьму»), and the guards' gates «Тюрьма: западные/южные ворота» (62275/62274) lead there only for the uprising, from a quarter of an hour before it.
RECOVERED. «Охранник санатория особого режима» is taken at the station any time and handed in at the prison when the guard needs hands: «Доброволец? ... Сейчас этот зоопарк полезет наружу» (62259).
RECOVERED times. «Патроны и афро владельцам склада», taken and handed in at the box only while the share-out lasts; who may take them is data/holdings.json's (data/quests.json holders).

loot.why: RECOVERED thing, DESIGNED chance. Red_Bandage, «Красная повязка ВХ» — «Красная повязка, сорванная с ваших соперников» (7323/7324): the proof the medics pay for («принесешь медикам доказательства отстрела урок», 62272). One on every prisoner and on the godfather, in the blocks only.

keep_in.why: RECOVERED rule. Томас, who leads out of the prison, «При выходе отбирает все повязки» (the wiki's «Томас»): the armbands stay in the blocks, whichever way the player leaves -- Томас's «Выход», a death sent home, a login elsewhere. DESIGNED: and no other way either -- the frame of a thing kept in carries the quest flag and no exchange (server/events.py kept, items.static_info), so no letter, lot, barter or stall takes one out, and a death does not drop it.
